page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6t.26xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the x86_64 architecture using KVM virtualization. It features 104 dedicated vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 8269CY processors operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is equipped with 192.0 GB of RAM, which equates to approximately 1.85 GB of memory per core.

This instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps and includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. It does not include local storage, requiring reliance on external network-attached block storage services. There are no discrete GPUs allocated to this instance profile. The hardware configuration emphasizes dense compute execution over memory capacity per thread.

The compute-heavy architecture with 104 dedicated vCPUs makes ecs.c6t.26xlarge qualitatively cost-efficient for highly parallel CPU workloads, batch processing, software compilation tasks, and high-throughput web serving where CPU core density is prioritized.

The lower memory-to-core ratio maximizes CPU core density, delivering a cost-efficient profile for CPU-bound batch processing, parallel build pipelines, and high-concurrency web serving workloads.
